name: DynamicQuantizeU8
adaptation: Asymmetrically quantize eight signed INT16 samples to UINT8 while returning the exact scale and zero point. Let L=min(0,X[0],...,X[7]), U=max(0,X[0],...,X[7]) and D=U-L, except D=1 when U=L=0. The scale is the exact rational D/255, not a floating-point bit pattern. Define E(n,d) as rounding exact n/d to nearest integer with ties to EVEN, for positive d. Set Z=E(-255*L,D) and Q[i]=clip(E(255*X[i],D)+Z,0,255). Round each scaled sample BEFORE adding Z. out_values[63:0] holds the eight bytes Q; bits [71:64] hold Z; bits [87:72] hold unsigned D. The zero vector yields Q=0, Z=0, D=1, following the archived reference zero-range branch. This preserves affine min/max calibration, inclusion of zero, separate round-to-even stages and returned scale; exact rational arithmetic replaces intermediate float32 arithmetic, so float32 boundary coincidences are not claimed identical.
